plan.notes: Official Fullerton College Program Pathways Mapper (fullcoll.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (20) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term.

courses.title: Choose a course
courses.choice_note: Choose one course per the official map's “Choose a course” requirement. The mapper's official choice record lists no structured options; see the official map description and catalog. Map description: Select one area of emphasis. Java & Mobile Applications, Web Programming, Database Management, or Game Programming. The list below does not divide the courses into their focus. Refer to the catalog to see courses divided into their focus groups.  https://catalog.nocccd.edu/fullerton-college/degrees-certificates/computer-information-systems/programming-certificate/
